instructions.name: bankroll_deposit
docs: Back the bankroll: USDC from your balance → LP shares at NAV (optimistic NAV: pending bets assumed to pay).

instructions.name: bankroll_withdraw
docs: Exit at pessimistic NAV (pending bets assumed to be paid) minus the exit fee, into your balance.

instructions.name: buy_shares
docs: Buy from a founder sale: USDC from your balance → seller's balance (minus platform fee); shares → your wallet.

instructions.name: claim_house
docs: Claim your share of the house's earnings into your balance. Also called internally before stake changes.

instructions.name: list_shares
docs: Founder sale: list shares from your wallet at a fixed price (USDC per whole share).

instructions.name: open_balance
docs: Create/refresh your balance and authorize a browser key. Deposits optional in the same tx.

instructions.name: place_bet
docs: Signed by the owner OR the authorized session key. Funded from the balance; winnings return to it.

accounts.name: signer
docs: owner or session key; pays rent + oracle fee

instructions.name: refund_bet
docs: Oracle never answered: stake back to the player's balance after the timeout.

instructions.name: settle_bet
docs: Permissionless. Pays the win, splits the edge, draws the jackpot ticket, credits the referrer, rewards the settler.

accounts.name: referrer_vault
docs: Referrer's balance vault (optional; must match balance.referrer)

instructions.name: stake
docs: Stake house shares (from your wallet) to earn; claims pending first.

errors.name: SaleAmount
errors.msg: sale exhausted or amount too large

types.name: Balance
docs: The user's one balance: USDC vault + long-lived browser session key.

types.name: House
docs: A creator's casino: brand + margin + earnings. Games are templates run under the house.

fields.name: num_received
docs: Total number of received requests.

fields.name: mint
docs: ORAO token mint address.

fields.name: treasury
docs: ORAO token treasury account.

fields.name: fee
docs: Fee in ORAO SPL token smallest units.

types.name: Sale
docs: Founder sale: fixed-price listing of house shares by any holder.

types.name: Template
docs: A game's math. Global; any house can run any enabled template.
